name: mac-doctor
description: Tiered macOS maintenance for a dev machine that agent CLIs, node/dev servers, Docker and Xcode have quietly filled up. Five launchd cadences (15m/1h/12h/1d/7d) whose autonomy widens as the cadence lengthens: short tiers act silently on provably-regenerable debris, long tiers propose and wait. Verification gates before every deletion, a findings ledger that makes recurring leaks visible, and measurement discipline that refuses to total a partial result.
